expect.question: What did the CFPB's 2025 medical debt rule change?

set.question: What happened to the CFPB's January 2025 rule removing medical debt from credit reports?

edits.claim: quiz question presents vacated CFPB rule as in force
edits.src: CFPB final rule Jan 7 2025 (Troutman/CFS Law Monitor coverage): would remove ~$49B in medical bills from reports of ~15M Americans; vacated July 11 2025 by U.S. District Court for E.D. Texas (Brownstein, cited [6] in Sanity body) — the fallback presented it as in force

expect.text: It removed medical debt from credit reports and prohibited using credit reporting to coerce payment

set.text: A federal court vacated it in July 2025, so the federal ban never took effect
